label: Deformation
text: EA.O.A2.2 Deformation. Stress and strain in rock. Brittle faulting dominates near the surface; ductile flow dominates at depth. A fold is geometry; a fault is a fracture with offset. Earthquake size: magnitude is a logarithmic measure. Moment magnitude Mw derives from seismic moment M₀ = μAD (rigidity, rupture area, mean slip). Radiated energy rises about 32 times per unit magnitude. Intensity is felt effect (USGS, cited in audit).
